phrases.latin: Prīmus omnium squalus praeterlāpsus est, longus, cānus, lentus, pinnā dorsālī ērēctā
phrases.english: First of all a shark glided past, long, grey, slow, its dorsal fin upright
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
